status: source-backed gas conductivity and vendor window conductivity; enclosure/material/accommodation hypotheses are not identified product inputs

gas_conductivity.author: Marcia L. Huber, NIST
gas_conductivity.title: Thermal Conductivity of Gases (2019)
gas_conductivity.pressure_domain: dilute-gas limiting conductivity; source says differences at 100 kPa generally below 1%
gas_conductivity.source_uncertainty: generally less than 3%; not a package temperature confidence interval
gas_conductivity.implemented_policy: linear interpolation only, fail closed outside 200..400 K
gas_conductivity.not_ingested: independent viscosity, accommodation measurements, mixtures or dense-gas transport

gap_theory.use: primary INL discussion of Kennard temperature-jump/accommodation gas-gap conduction
gap_theory.implementation_limits: Eucken viscosity and constant ideal-gas gamma/Cp are declared approximations; harmonic projected first-hit gaps are an enclosure-film reduction, not a gas-volume PDE

window.material: ZnSe candidate, not identified manufactured window
window.unqualified: coatings, spectral LWIR emissivity/absorption/transmission, external radiance, low-temperature grade dependence
window.model: internal opaque diffuse-gray epsilon 0.1 or sensitivity 0.8, tau=0; outer window adiabatic. This does not predict optical transmission.

geometry.pinout: unknown; instance labels are construction IDs, never OEM electrical pin numbers
